spec.name: Orange Kitchen Noodles
spec.description: A loose nest of golden egg noodles with broad folded ribbons, stepped coils and curled ends. Warm dough shading and restrained flour highlights emphasize an appetizing ingredient silhouette. Ground rests at y=0.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Noodles. Recognizable prepared cooking ingredient. Flour/salt/grounds in a small open paper packet or bowl, liquids in a little bottle, dough soft and folded, meat textured and distinct. Pick the correct form for the item. Actual recipe ingredients: dough, egg. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
